text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap delivers a brilliant 
performance, defeating Super Creek at the 
Arima Kinen.

After the race, Tamamo Cross visits the 
waiting room, announcing she is giving up 
on the Dream Trophy to challenge the two 
of them instead.

Disheartened by the sudden appearance of a 
rival, Oguri Cap finds herself at the dawn 
of a new era of trials.
